thread:
kai: Hey team — heads up I'm moving my primary work location from Melbourne to Toronto for family reasons. Target move date July 15. Is this a payroll cutover or can I stay on AU payroll for a while? Also: how does WFH stipend work when moving countries mid-quarter?

maria (People Ops): @kai thanks for the heads up. Quick q: permanent move or long-term temporary? Any change to employment status ( contractor vs employee )?

kai: Permanent — family relocating. Still a Redwood employee. No change to role.

lee (Payroll): For a permanent change we normally transition payroll to the Canada payroll. That affects tax withholding, CPP vs AUS super, and benefits enrollment. We need official move date + Canadian address.

alex (Manager): Team supports the move. Happy to confirm role continuity for any local filings.

tara (Tax): Canada has provincial residency rules — Ontario will apply. Also check any Australian tax exit requirements. We'll prepare a cross-border tax memo. Could affect RSU tax timing.

sophia (Benefits): Benefits mapping: some US/AU benefits won't carry. For Canada we'll show equivalent coverage or transitional top-up. Also note: health coverage start dates may have waiting periods.

maria (People Ops): WFH stipend: our policy pays stipend for your primary home workspace in the country of record. On permanent move we stop AU stipend and start Canada stipend (amount differs). If you move mid-quarter we'll prorate the final AU payment and start Canada allowance from payroll cutover date.

kai: Got it. Any action I should take now?

lee (Payroll): Actions for @kai: 1) upload passport and proof of Canadian address when available (relocate.redwood) 2) choose payroll transition option in form (we recommend full Canada payroll for permanency) 3) provide final AU payroll end date.

maria (People Ops): Also submit relocation assistance form for shipping and home setup. Link: https://go.redwoodinference.com/relocate

tara (Tax): We'll run a double-tax check and advise on RSU/ISO exercise timing. If you have planned equity moves, pause for 30 days until we confirm.

sophia (Benefits): I'll map coverage and follow up with enrollment steps and any top-up details.

hr-bot: Reminder: change-of-address impacts payroll tax codes and emergency contacts. Update People Portal.

kai: Thanks all  I'll submit docs this week and hold off on any RSU exercises. Appreciate the quick help.

maria (People Ops): Marking status: relocation in progress. We'll post final payroll cutover date once Payroll & Tax finish checks. :white_check_mark:
